objective: Al terminar usas la pasiva avanzada (con modales, perfecta, continua e infinitivos) para describir acciones y resultados con objetividad.

warmup.prompt_es: En textos científicos, noticias y reportes la pasiva es la norma: 'Se han plantado diez mil árboles', 'Debe hacerse algo', 'Se está investigando'. Aquí consolidas todas las formas.

text: Forests are being cleared at an alarming rate. According to a recent report, an area the size of a football pitch is lost every six seconds. In response, a new reforestation programme has been launched, and over ten million trees have already been planted. However, much more needs to be done.

The project is being funded by several governments, and it is hoped that it will be completed by 2035. Local communities are being trained to manage the forests, and by next year, a monitoring system will have been installed. If nothing is done, the damage may never be reversed.

It has been argued that companies should be held responsible for the damage they cause. The new law, which was passed last month, requires them to be audited every year. Anyone who is found to have broken the rules can be fined or banned from operating. What is needed now is public support: awareness must be raised, and pressure must be put on governments to act.
input.es: Los bosques se están talando a un ritmo alarmante. Según un informe reciente, se pierde una superficie del tamaño de un campo de fútbol cada seis segundos. En respuesta, se ha lanzado un nuevo programa de reforestación y ya se han plantado más de diez millones de árboles. Sin embargo, queda mucho por hacer. El proyecto está siendo financiado por varios gobiernos y se espera que esté terminado en 2035. Se está formando a las comunidades locales para gestionar los bosques y para el año que viene se habrá instalado un sistema de vigilancia. Si no se hace nada, puede que el daño nunca se revierta. Se ha argumentado que las empresas deberían ser consideradas responsables del daño que causan. La nueva ley, aprobada el mes pasado, exige que sean auditadas cada año. A cualquiera que se descubra incumpliendo las normas se le puede multar o prohibir operar. Lo que se necesita ahora es apoyo público: hay que concienciar y presionar a los gobiernos para que actúen.

md_es: **Pasiva avanzada: todas las formas**
| Tiempo / forma | Estructura | Ejemplo |
| Presente simple | *am / is / are + participio* | *Trees **are planted** every year.* |
| Presente continuo | *is / are being + participio* | *Forests **are being cleared**.* |
| Pasado simple | *was / were + participio* | *The law **was passed** last month.* |
| Pasado continuo | *was / were being + participio* | *The report **was being written**.* |
| Present perfect | *has / have been + participio* | *Ten million trees **have been planted**.* |
| Past perfect | *had been + participio* | *It **had been banned** before.* |
| Futuro | *will be + participio* | *It **will be completed** by 2035.* |
| Futuro perfecto | *will have been + participio* | *A system **will have been installed**.* |
| Modal | *can / must / should / may be + participio* | *Something **must be done**.* |
| Modal perfecto | *should / could / must have been + participio* | *It **should have been done** earlier.* |
| Infinitivo | *to be + participio* | *It needs **to be done**.* |
| Infinitivo perfecto | *to have been + participio* | *It is believed **to have been built** in 1900.* |
| Gerundio | *being + participio* | *I hate **being told** what to do.* |
**Pasiva con dos objetos**
- *They gave her a prize.* → *She was given a prize.* / *A prize was given to her.* (preferible la persona como sujeto).
- *Verbos:* give, send, offer, tell, show, teach, pay, lend.
**Get passive (informal)**
- *He got fined.* · *The window got broken.* · *She got promoted.* (algo que ocurre, a menudo inesperado).
**Pasiva impersonal (repaso)**
- *It is said that … · It has been argued that … · It is hoped that …*
**Agente: cuándo usar by**
- Se omite si es obvio, desconocido o sin importancia. Se incluye si es relevante: *The law was passed by Parliament.*
**Errores típicos**
- ✘ *The law passed last month.* → ✔ *The law was passed last month.*
- ✘ *It has been built since 1900.* → ✔ *It was built in 1900.*
- ✘ *Something must do.* → ✔ *Something must be done.*
- ✘ *The house is being build.* → ✔ *The house is being built.*
- ✘ *She was given a prize by me* (innecesario) → ✔ *I gave her a prize.*
**Ojo:** verbos intransitivos no tienen pasiva (*happen, arrive, die, occur, appear*): ✘ *It was happened.* → ✔ *It happened.* Evita la pasiva si hace la frase confusa o impersonal sin necesidad.
Pronunciación: *planted* /ˈplɑːntɪd/ · *funded* /ˈfʌndɪd/ · *audited* /ˈɔːdɪtɪd/ (la 'ed' se pronuncia /ɪd/ tras t/d).
